---
title: "Admin Moderation Dashboard"
---

This dashboard allows authorized administrators to manage cohort submissions.
If you are not an administrator, the backend edge relay will mathematically reject your requests regardless of what buttons you click here.

<div id="admin-auth-warning" class="alert alert-warning mt-4">
  Loading authentication status...
</div>

<div class="card mb-4 mt-4" id="admin-panel" style="display: none;">
  <div class="card-header bg-danger text-white">
    Cohort Moderation Tools
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">
    <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
      <div class="col-md-3">
        <label>Topic</label>
        <input type="text" id="mod-topic" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. nf-set-theory">
      </div>
      <div class="col-md-3">
        <label>Cohort ID</label>
        <input type="text" id="mod-cohort" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. default">
      </div>
      <div class="col-md-3">
        <label>Problem ID</label>
        <input type="text" id="mod-problem" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. exercise-1">
      </div>
      <div class="col-md-3">
        <label>Target Username</label>
        <input type="text" id="mod-username" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. ryanncode">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex gap-2">
      <button class="btn btn-outline-danger" onclick="executeAdminAction('admin_delete_submission')">Delete Submission</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-warning" onclick="executeAdminAction('admin_edit_submission')">Hide Submission (WIP)</button>
    </div>
    <div id="admin-result" class="mt-3"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('tl_study_token');
    if (!token) {
        document.getElementById('admin-auth-warning').textContent = "You are not authenticated via GitHub OAuth. Please log in first.";
        document.getElementById('admin-auth-warning').className = "alert alert-danger mt-4";
        return;
    }
    
    // We assume the user is authenticated. 
    // True admin status is verified mathematically on the backend.
    document.getElementById('admin-auth-warning').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('admin-panel').style.display = 'block';
});

async function executeAdminAction(actionType) {
    const topic = document.getElementById('mod-topic').value;
    const cohort = document.getElementById('mod-cohort').value || 'default';
    const problem = document.getElementById('mod-problem').value;
    const username = document.getElementById('mod-username').value;
    const resultDiv = document.getElementById('admin-result');
    const token = localStorage.getItem('tl_study_token');
    
    if (!topic || !problem || !username) {
        resultDiv.innerHTML = `<span class="text-danger">Topic, Problem ID, and Username are required.</span>`;
        return;
    }
    
    resultDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Executing...</span>';
    
    try {
        let res;
        if (actionType === 'admin_delete_submission') {
            const url = `https://tl-study-relay.ryann.workers.dev/?action=admin_delete_submission&topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}&cohortId=${encodeURIComponent(cohort)}&problemId=${encodeURIComponent(problem)}&targetUsername=${encodeURIComponent(username)}`;
            res = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'DELETE',
                headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
            });
        } else if (actionType === 'admin_edit_submission') {
            const url = `https://tl-study-relay.ryann.workers.dev/`;
            res = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    action: 'admin_edit_submission',
                    topic: topic,
                    cohortId: cohort,
                    problemId: problem,
                    targetUsername: username,
                    solution_data: "[This submission was hidden by a moderator.]",
                    comments: []
                })
            });
        }
        
        const data = await res.json();
        
        if (res.ok) {
            resultDiv.innerHTML = `<span class="text-success fw-bold">Success!</span> <br> <pre class="mt-2">${JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}</pre>`;
        } else {
            resultDiv.innerHTML = `<span class="text-danger fw-bold">Action Failed (${res.status}):</span> <br> ${data.error || JSON.stringify(data)}`;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        resultDiv.innerHTML = `<span class="text-danger fw-bold">Error:</span> ${e.message}`;
    }
}
</script>
